datasets.name: Landslide VOC dataset (merged CAS landslides dataset and Landsat 8 images)
datasets.verbatim: a landslide VOC dataset was curated by merging the CAS landslides dataset with remote sensing images sourced from Landsat 8, subsequently utilized for training the Faster-RCNN model

methods.name: Improved Faster-RCNN with ResNet-50 backbone
methods.summary: The authors utilize a Faster-RCNN model with a ResNet-50 backbone for landslide detection. The model is enhanced by segmenting remote sensing images into smaller units (256x256) for batch processing and stitching the results to cover the large study area.
methods.verbatim: In this study, the experimental environment utilized the 12th generation Intel® CoreTM i7-12700H CPU, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, the PyTorch framework, and the ResNet-50 backbone network... we enhance the Faster-RCNN model by incorporating image segmentation and fusion capabilities.

reproducibility_assessment: Input datasets are practically accessible via public providers, but the landslide inventory used for training is not referenced or linked. The custom code for the improved Faster-RCNN model lacks a repository or persistent link.
